**Launch command I would use**, assuming the repo exists at `~/Projects/example-site`. I haven't confirmed a house launcher for background sessions, so this is plain `claude -p` in print mode, backgrounded with `nohup`:

```bash
REPO=~/Projects/example-site
JOBS=/var/home/glw907/.claude/jobs/0a745dfc/tmp/runs/1-haiku-off
claude-worktree-busy "$REPO" && \
cd "$REPO" && \
nohup claude -p "$(cat "$JOBS/brief-mobile-nav.md")" \
  --model claude-sonnet-5-5 \
  > "$JOBS/mobile-nav.log" 2>&1 &
```

The brief file doesn't exist yet. It would not refer to this conversation. The log goes in the jobs directory, not the repo, so it can't be committed. Sonnet fits the build, since the edits are mechanical. The reviews are judgment, so a reviewer pass may warrant Opus.

**What I'd check before running:**

6. The task runs 45 minutes. Past about 30 minutes unattended, the guards in `~/.claude/docs/unattended-work-guards.md` must be armed first.
7. The brief names a model and an effort, since house rules require both. I haven't confirmed a flag for effort, so I'd put it in the brief text.
